CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.practitioners
    WHERE id = auth.uid() AND is_admin = true
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_is_member_of(org_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.organization_members
    WHERE user_id = auth.uid() AND organization_id = org_id
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  new_org_id uuid;
BEGIN
  -- 1. Créer le profil Praticien
  INSERT INTO public.practitioners (id, email, credits, encryption_salt, encryption_validator)
  VALUES (
    NEW.id, 
    NEW.email, 
    3, 
    'pending', 'pending'
  );

  -- 2. Créer l'Organisation par défaut
  INSERT INTO public.organizations (name)
  VALUES ('Cabinet ' || NEW.email)
  RETURNING id INTO new_org_id;

  -- 3. Ajouter le Praticien comme Owner
  INSERT INTO public.organization_members (organization_id, user_id, role, encrypted_org_key)
  VALUES (new_org_id, NEW.id, 'owner', NULL);

  -- 4. Créer l'abonnement Trial (avec date de fin !)
  INSERT INTO public.subscriptions (user_id, plan_id, status, trial_ends_at)
  VALUES (NEW.id, 'free', 'trialing', now() + interval '14 days');

  RETURN NEW;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  -- Log l'erreur mais ne bloque pas la création Auth
  RAISE WARNING 'handle_new_user partial failure for %: %', NEW.id, SQLERRM;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.norm_name(input text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
AS $function$
    SELECT regexp_replace(lower(public.unaccent(trim(COALESCE(input, '')))), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_sensitive_updates()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Si l'utilisateur tente de changer ses crédits ou son statut admin via un UPDATE classique
  IF (NEW.credits IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credits) OR (NEW.is_admin IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.is_admin) THEN
    -- On autorise seulement si c'est un "super admin" ou une fonction serveur (auth.role() = 'service_role')
    -- Mais ici, pour simplifier, on rejette tout update direct venant du contexte utilisateur
    IF auth.uid() = NEW.id THEN 
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Vous ne pouvez pas modifier vos crédits manuellement.';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
